Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
GAME: Oxygen Not Included (Spaced Out). Cycle 2. Screen ~1280x720 (normalize x/1280, y/720). Dupes: Bubbles, Gossmann, Ashkan. Win goals: 200 cycles, 16 morale, 12 dupes, Great Monument, Temporal Tear.

CONTROLS (observed): Build tabs at y~0.930: Base .028, Oxygen .064, Power .100, Food .135, Plumbing .170, Ventilation .205, Refinement .241, Medicine .277, Furniture .313, Stations .348. First icon in a build panel is at ~(0.045, 0.775) — confirmed Plumbing icon row y=0.775 NOT 0.558 (0.558 hits game-world tiles). Pitcher Pump icon ~(0.045,0.775), Outhouse ~(0.099,0.775), Bottle Emptier ~(0.154,0.775). Placement: click icon, move cursor to target, verify WHITE ghost + 'CLICK TO BUILD', click at SAME cursor position (ghost art renders above cursor). Red ghost 'Must be built in unoccupied space' = dupe/building overlap. Right-click exits placement/Dig/Cancel tools (~0.4-0.75, 0.4-0.75 worked). G=Dig tool. Cancel button (0.703,0.967). Wheel zoom. 'd' pans right. Tab cycles simulation speed (confirmed: dupes started deliveries after Tab). 's' pans camera down, 'w' pans up. Do NOT click 'Select Blueprint' (opens Database; close X ~(0.976-0.984, 0.150-0.363)). Clicking gas/resource tiles opens their info panels, not buildings. Escape may toggle overlays. Repeated clicks on same tile cycle selected layer (e.g., Dig→Bottle Emptier).

CONFIRMED STATE:
- 3 Cots, Wire, Manual Generator (Gossmann cranking), Oxygen Diffuser (powered -120W, running, Algae 800 kg supply good). O2 trend: 141→171→243→731→994→1256→1599→3000g at points; currently breathable. CO2 pools low (sinks). Microbe Musher BUILT on ledge at ~(0.36-0.47, 0.46-0.68) depending on view; yellow flask shape.
- Mush Bar recipe: Ingredient #1 Dirt 75kg (1620-1900kg available). Ingredient #2 UNDISCOVERED ('No ingredients discovered') — 'Alternative ingredient options are available' note. Order Production DISABLED. Hypothesis: Ingredient #2 is Water (Tutorial: Fetching Water appeared simultaneously). Water pool in lower cave: 1000 kg, 21.7C, clean.
- Bottle Emptier blueprint placed on ledge floor at ~(0.44, 0.52-0.74) (Sandstone 400kg consumed 10.3t→9.9t). Construction was in progress (Sandstone deliveries, sparks visible). Status after pan-up unclear.
- Two Pitcher Pump blueprints were placed in lower water cave — BOTH UNREACHABLE ('Unreachable Build'). Both CANCELLED via Cancel Build button at (0.823-0.824, 0.840).
- Lower water cave is physically DISCONNECTED from main ledge — no path exists. Left side of lower cave has small platform at ~(0.15-0.22, 0.42) with yellow Muckroot plant — may indicate a reachable path from far left.
- Resources: Copper Ore ~2421kg (fluctuates), Coal 296kg, Sand ~2420kg, Sandstone ~9.9t, Muckroot 3200 kcal, Food 15,704 kcal (flat entire game). Lower cave: Cultivable Soil ~1900kg, Water pool 1000kg, Algae 197-800kg.
- Diagnostics: Idleness 1-2 (fluctuating); 'No Wash Basin built' intermittent (cleared then returned); 'Entombed' alert was a Buried Object under Sandstone at ~(0.39,0.29) — never investigated. Colony Achievement earned. Dupe morale 2-3, stress 0%, some low stamina.

FAILED STRATEGIES:
- Pitcher Pump placement in water cave: ALL attempts placed on unreachable tiles (no path from ledge). Both cancelled.
- Bottle Emptier first placement: landed in mid-air inside Coal/rock tile ('Unreachable Dig'). Cancelled, re-placed on ledge floor.
- Repeated clicks hitting gas/resource tiles instead of building blueprints (O2 panels, Sand, Fertilizer, Algae, Water panels opened accidentally). Solution: panel X at ~(0.977-0.984, 0.357-0.363); tile selection cycles on repeated clicks.

ACTIVE GOALS:
1. Cancel/avoid unreachable water infrastructure. Two options: (a) dig a passage from ledge down to water cave, or (b) check Mush Bar 'Alternative ingredient options' for non-water Ingredient #2.
2. Verify Bottle Emptier completed on ledge.
3. Once Ingredient #2 discovered, queue Mush Bar in Musher Config tab (recipe row at ~(0.66, 0.742), count box ~(0.748,0.742)).
4. Build Wash Basin (diagnostic active; likely Medicine tab x~0.277 or Furniture x~0.313).
5. Investigate Entombed/Buried Object at ~(0.39,0.29).
6. Long-term: farm Mealwood on lower-cave dirt; handle CO2; monitor Algae.

UNCERTAIN: Whether lower cave is reachable via far-left path (Muckroot platform suggests maybe). Whether Bottle Emptier is complete. Whether Mush Bar can use non-water ingredient. Why construction sometimes stalls (socializing, idle). Camera coordinates shift after panning (ledge floor y varies 0.37-0.74 by view).
